n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right. Family meeting. Ryan — sit down. Phone on the table. Parents' evening was… interesting.

translations.fa: خب. جلسهٔ خانوادگی. رایان — بشین. گوشی رو میز. جلسهٔ اولیا… جالب بود.

branches.suggestion: Don't worry, Ryan. It's not bad!
Ryan, put your phone down, please.
branches.suggestionFa: رایان، لطفاً گوشیت را بذار زمین.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Here we go. What did Patel say? Was it bad? I bet it was bad.

translations.fa: شروع شد. پاتل چی گفت؟ بد بود؟ شرط می‌بندم بد بود.

branches.suggestion: It wasn't bad, Ryan. It was mostly good!
branches.suggestionFa: بد نبود رایان. بیشترش خوب بود!

branches.suggestion: Mr Patel said you're doing well.
branches.suggestionFa: آقای پاتل گفت خوب پیش میری.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The good news: a predicted 7 in Computing. That's brilliant, son. And Mr Patel said you're kind to the younger kids.

translations.fa: خبر خوب: پیش‌بینی ۷ تو کامپیوتر. عالیه پسرم. آقای پاتل گفت با بچه‌های کوچیک‌تر مهربونی.

branches.suggestion: Well done, Ryan! A 7 is great.
You're good with the little ones, Ryan.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Seriously? He said that? Nice. So… what's the bad news?

translations.fa: جدی؟ اینو گفت؟ خوبه. پس… خبر بد چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Maths. Mr Patel said you need to work on algebra.
branches.suggestionFa: ریاضی. آقای پاتل گفت باید روی جبر کار کنی.

branches.suggestion: Five pieces of homework were late.

cultureNote.en: To report speech, use "said that…": Mr Patel said that Ryan was kind. "Told" needs a person: He told us that…
cultureNote.fa: برای نقل قول از «said that» استفاده کنید؛ «told» به مفعول نیاز دارد.

recasts.better: Mr Patel said that you need to work on algebra.
recasts.betterFa: آقای پاتل گفت که باید روی جبر کار کنی.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Five late, Ryan. "I did it on the bus," you said! So we've decided. From now on: homework seven to eight. Phone in the kitchen.

translations.fa: پنج تا دیر، رایان. گفتی «تو اتوبوس انجامش دادم»! پس تصمیم گرفتیم. از حالا به بعد: تکلیف هفت تا هشت. گوشی تو آشپزخونه.

branches.suggestion: Seven to eight. That's a good plan.
Ryan, it's only for homework time.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: In the KITCHEN? That's not fair! Everyone in Year 10 has their phone. What if someone messages me?

translations.fa: تو آشپزخونه؟ منصفانه نیست! همهٔ کلاس دهمیا گوشیشون پیششونه. اگه یکی بهم پیام بده چی؟

branches.suggestion: It's only one hour, Ryan.
They can wait an hour. It's OK.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونن یه ساعت صبر کنن. اشکالی نداره.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: One hour. And here's the deal — our lodger likes algebra. Strange man. He can help you on Mondays and Thursdays.

translations.fa: یه ساعت. و قرارمون اینه — مستأجرمون جبر دوست داره. آدم عجیبیه. می‌تونه دوشنبه‌ها و پنج‌شنبه‌ها کمکت کنه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I can help you, Ryan.
Strange? I just like numbers!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: You like algebra? For real? OK… if you explain it better than Mr Patel, maybe.

translations.fa: تو جبر دوست داری؟ واقعاً؟ باشه… اگه بهتر از آقای پاتل توضیح بدی، شاید.

branches.suggestion: Deal. We start on Monday!
Algebra is like a puzzle. You'll like it.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: And if your Maths goes up to a 5 by summer… I'll teach you to drive in the car park. When you're seventeen. Don't tell your mum.

translations.fa: و اگه ریاضیت تا تابستون به ۵ رسید… تو پارکینگ رانندگی یادت میدم. وقتی هفده سالت شد. به مامانت نگو.

branches.suggestion: Tom! Leslie will find out!
That's a great prize, Ryan.

n10.speaker: ryan
n10.text: A 5? Easy. Shake on it, Dad. And I want that in writing.

translations.fa: ۵؟ آسونه. دست بده بابا. اینو کتبی می‌خوام.

branches.suggestion: I'm the witness! I heard it.
Ha! Write it on the fridge.

n11.speaker: tom
n11.text: On the fridge, signed by the lodger. Official. Now — phone in the kitchen. Starting… now. Ha! Look at his face!

translations.fa: رو یخچال، با امضای مستأجر. رسمی. حالا — گوشی تو آشپزخونه. از… همین الان. ها! قیافه‌اش را ببین!
